messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] 1987654321 - p99 latency and 5xx jump on /v1/chat.generate observed after canary. 5xx ~ 3.4% (baseline ~0.02%). Paging oncall.

kai.li: I'm oncall. Pulling deploy diff + router traces now.

sam.green: edge is returning 502/504 with upstream read timeout. Canary image tag: v2.15.3-canary. Traffic at ~6%.

alyssa.chen: CS flags from a major customer reporting timeouts. Recommend pausing the ramp immediately while we triage.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: service=inference-canary image=registry/redwood/inference:v2.15.3-canary started=1987654200 strategy=canary(6%).

mike.ramirez: release notes mention "kv-prefix remap" + decoder micro-ops. Could be remap causing hot-shard evictions.

sam.green: logs show rising "kv: evict shard=12" and decoder durations spike on quant path. Router queue_depth metric also climbing.

kai.li: mitigation options: A) immediate rollback to v2.15.2-stable, B) divert canary traffic to dedicated-fallback, C) pause and run warmup for top keys. Fastest is rollback.

alyssa.chen: rollback + notify customers. ProductOps draft note and incident ticket.

product-ops: opened INC-2028-330. Notifying CS and account owners. ETA next update 10m.

kai.li: executing rollback: kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-canary inference=registry/redwood/inference:v2.15.2-stable && kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-canary -w

sam.green: lowering router upstream timeout for canary route from 75s -> 40s and enabling short-circuit cb to shed load.

oncall-bot: action logged: rollback_initiated by kai.li @ 1987654475

mike.ramirez: launching one-off warmup job to prefill hot keys: job/warm-kv --target=inference-canary --keys=top-1000

kai.li: rollback in progress. Old pods terminating; new v2.15.2-stable pods creating.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: service=inference-canary from=v2.15.3-canary to=v2.15.2-stable completed=1987654608

sam.green: metrics: p95 fell from ~580ms -> ~120ms within 30s of rollback. 5xx trending down to 0.5%.

cs-ops: customer note posted: "We observed elevated timeouts after a canary deploy and rolled back the canary image. Services are stabilizing; no data loss reported." :white_check_mark:

kai.li: quick triage: kv-prefix remap changed key hashing leading to concentrated hotspots and LRU churn; combined with quantized decoder path this amplified tail latency.

mike.ramirez: will open PR to revert the remap and add a deterministic shard-distribution test. Also adding a warmup step into the canary pipeline to pre-seed caches before ramp.

sam.green: gateway saw short connection queueing and retries; suggestion: add health gates during ramp based on kv_miss_rate and router_queue_depth.

product-ops: incident status: mitigated (rollback complete, customers notified). Postmortem scheduled in 48h. Severity set SEV2 (customer visible degradation).

oncall-bot: handoff reminder: next oncall @alyssa.chen in 40m. Please record follow-ups in INC-2028-330.

alyssa.chen: taking handoff. Runbook notes added: watch p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv.eviction count, and router queue_length. Re-page if p99 > 300ms or 5xx > 1%.

kai.li: leaving timeline + key logs in INC-2028-330 and tagging @mike.ramirez for the code fix.

mike.ramirez: ack. Drafting PR: revert-kv-remap + canary-warmup + shard-dist-test. Will include quant-path perf checks.

sam.green: 12m post-rollback: p95=110ms, p99=180ms, 5xx=0.12% — stable for handoff.

alyssa.chen: handing off to night crew. Will review PR in morning. Closing active paging for now. :coffee:

product-ops: created follow-ups: TASK-9001 add canary warmup, TASK-9002 add shard-distribution simulation, TASK-9003 add ramp health gates. PM sync scheduled.

oncall-bot: incident mitigated at 1987655250. All actions logged.
